parsed_json.up: Select compounds with IC50 activities in nM against human RAC-alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase (CHEMBL4282). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary filtering by target chembl_id and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Join docs to obtain pubmed_id or doi as pubmed_id_or_doi. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
